description: A minimalist outdoor terrace or pool deck vignette photographed at deep dusk, with a calm open ocean filling the entire background horizon. The sky is a layered gradient from pale blush pink and peach near the horizon through a warm lilac-mauve band to a deep cool steel blue overhead, with no clouds. The ocean surface is still and mirror-like in this light. In the soft-focus background, two or three wide outdoor sun loungers with white cushions are barely visible on a pale stone or concrete terrace deck, alongside dark wood furniture frames. A warm amber glow from a low source in the background distance adds a secondary point of warmth to the far left of the scene. The central foreground is dominated by a large solid square pedestal or plinth in rich dark walnut or teak — a cube form with a pronounced natural wood grain, its square top surface nearly filling the bottom quarter of the frame. On top of the wood pedestal sits a large perfectly spherical form in luminous opal-white, glowing from within with a warm golden-white light that diffuses evenly through its surface, casting a warm amber pool onto the top of the wooden cube below it. Camera is at a very low angle, approximately 2–3 feet, shooting nearly eye-level with the top surface of the pedestal. The lens is a normal focal length with a very shallow depth of field, keeping the glowing sphere and the pedestal surface sharp while the entire background terrace and ocean are a soft gradient blur. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
